independentLayers.description: The data-* state contract (Base UI names): field state and per-control state maps that both renderers set (React through components/state.react.ts).
Combobox and listbox ARIA, key intents and typeahead.
The floating layer foundation: the positioner (CSS anchor positioning, script placement as the fallback, data-side), the dismiss layer (outside press) and the top layer (popover API).
Reference numbers for the trigger and popup offset.

intent: Choose one value from a list of options that opens on demand

properties.description: Form field name; the host submits its value under this name. Reflected because the form reads the attribute.
Blocks interaction and submission. An ancestor <fieldset disabled> has the same effect without setting this property (isDisabled).
Requires a value. The error shows only after the user leaves the field or a submit is blocked.
The selected option value. The value attribute at connect is the reset default.
Base UI defaultValue: the value at first render (when no value attribute or property set it) and after form reset. Without it, the value attribute is the default, like a native input's.
Base UI open: whether the popup is shown. Setting it opens or closes the popup without an openchange event; user interaction updates it after openchange.
Base UI defaultOpen: open the popup when the element connects.
Shown in the trigger when no option matches the value.
Ids (space-separated) that name the trigger and the popup listbox when label is empty; a wrapping ui-field sets it. Forwarded to aria-labelledby on both.
Ids (space-separated) that describe the trigger, after its own description and error ids; a wrapping ui-field sets it.

attributes.name: size
attributes.description: Sets the unit u (px) for this element and its subtree: one of the SIZES steps 2…12 (data-size is the same input). Lengths scale from u; type follows 10px + u.

attributes.name: gap
attributes.description: Gutter between children in units of u, 0…8 in 0.5 steps. Default: the container level's padding.

attributes.name: hide-label
attributes.description: Keeps the label as the control's accessible name but does not draw it (visually hidden, out of flow). For compact layouts that label the control elsewhere, such as an inspector row. data-hide-label is the same input; React: hideLabel.

events.name: input
events.trigger: an option is committed with a new value (same moment as change)

events.name: change
events.detail: { value: string, reason: 'item-press' | 'focus-out', event: Event } (Base UI onValueChange)
events.trigger: an option is committed with a new value: pressed, Enter / Space on the highlighted one, or Tab

events.name: openchange
events.detail: { open: boolean, reason: 'trigger-press' | 'list-navigation' | 'item-press' | 'outside-press' | 'escape-key' | 'focus-out', event: Event } (Base UI onOpenChange)
events.trigger: the user opens or closes the popup; preventDefault keeps it as it is. Setting open does not fire it

methods.name: checkValidity
methods.description: Runs validation; fires invalid when it fails.

methods.name: reportValidity
methods.description: Marks the field touched (errors show) and reports.

methods.name: setCustomValidity
methods.description: Sets an author error; an empty string clears it.

keyboard.action: open on the first / last option (closed); move (open)

content.children: ui-option elements (they move into the popup) and optional adornments with slot="leading" | "prefix" | "suffix" (they move into the trigger); or the parts themselves as [data-part] children (composition).

constraints: Select-only combobox (APG): focus stays on the trigger; aria-activedescendant points at the highlighted option. Contains no native form elements; form participation goes through ElementInternals (UIFormElement).
Authored ui-option children move into the popup, including options added later.
The value attribute at connect is the reset default. Option value falls back to its label text.
Outside pointerdown and blur close the popup; selection commits on Enter, Space, Tab or click.

Styling state (contracts/states.json, Base UI Select names): the host carries the field state (data-disabled, data-required, data-valid / data-invalid, data-dirty, data-touched, data-filled, data-focused); the trigger data-popup-open, data-pressed (while open), data-placeholder and data-disabled; the popup data-open / data-closed, data-side and data-align; options data-selected, data-highlighted and data-disabled. The React Select keeps the open state, option selection and highlight native (select:open, :checked, :focus).

The popup is placed with CSS anchor positioning (anchor-scope per select, position-area below the trigger, flip-block to the side with more room, min-width = trigger width, 1u gap). Where anchor positioning is unavailable, the floating positioner (dom/floating.ts createPositioner, placeFloating) measures the trigger and writes the position inline as a fallback.

Composition: the parts may be authored as [data-part] children (label, trigger › leading · prefix · value · suffix · icon, popup › list › ui-option, description, error); the host adopts each onto its generated part (the author attributes and classes; slot and icon content; label, description, error and the value text seed those properties and the placeholder) and generates the rest, so the DOM, classes and data-* match the generated anatomy. React: Select.Root with Select.Label, Select.Trigger (Select.Value, Select.Icon), Select.Popup › Select.List › Select.Item (Select.ItemText, Select.ItemIndicator), Select.Description and Select.Error as direct children; the Root puts Trigger and Popup inside the native <select>; Popup and List render no element (::picker(select)); every React part takes render (an element or (props, state) => element) and className (a string or (state) => string); the recipe class and data-* stay on whatever renders.

avoidWhen.when: Two to five options that should all stay visible.
avoidWhen.reason: A popup hides the choices; Segmented or a radio group shows them at once.

avoidWhen.when: A list that should always be visible, such as a sidebar of items.
avoidWhen.reason: Listbox keeps the options on the page.

avoidWhen.when: Typing to filter a long list.
avoidWhen.reason: This is select-only; a combobox filters as the user types.
Single select only; use checkboxes or selectable chips.

nodes.summary: The combobox (role=combobox, tabindex 0) laid out as [leading] [prefix] [value] [suffix] [icon] (Base UI Select.Trigger); keeps focus while the popup is open.
The selected option label, or the placeholder (data-placeholder); Base UI Select.Value, in the construction pattern's contents place.
The caret-down icon (Base UI Select.Icon, in the construction pattern's trailing place; icon size sm); turns 180° when open.
The [popover=manual] listbox on bg.overlay (Base UI Select.Popup) holding the list; placed 1u from the trigger.
The ui-option children's parent (Base UI Select.List; the options are its items), display: contents so the options lay out in the popup. Web component only: the native select has none.
